title: Introduction to clover
text: vignette demonstrates clover’s analysis workflow using E. coli tRNA sequencing data T4 phage infection time-course experiment. test dataset includes 6 samples: 3 uninfected controls (ctl) 3 T4-infected (inf) wild-type E. coli 15 minutes post-infection, 3 biological replicates per condition.

title: Introduction to clover

SE object contains: assay “counts”: abundance count matrix (charged + uncharged reads) colData: sample metadata condition labels metadata: list raw charging data, bcerror, odds ratios, FASTA reference, pipeline config

title: Introduction to clover
text: can test differential tRNA abundance infected uninfected conditions using DESeq2 wrappers. Volcano plot differential tRNA abundance (inf vs ctl).
code: counts <- assay(se, "counts") coldata <- as.data.frame(colData(se))  dds <- run_deseq(counts, coldata, design = ~condition) #> estimating size factors #> estimating dispersions #> gene-wise dispersion estimates #> mean-dispersion relationship #> final dispersion estimates #> fitting model and testing res <- tidy_deseq_results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "inf", "ctl")) plot_volcano(res)

title: Introduction to clover
code: tabulate_deseq(res)

title: Introduction to clover
text: unique feature nanopore tRNA-seq ability measure charging levels. can test whether ratio charged uncharged reads changes upon infection. Change charging ratio (infected - control) per tRNA.
code: charging <- metadata(se)$charging charging$condition <- ifelse(grepl("ctl", charging$sample_id), "ctl", "inf")  ratio_diff <- compute_charging_diffs(   charging,   numerator = "inf",   denominator = "ctl",   min_count = 50,   n_top = 20 )  plot_charging_diffs(ratio_diff)

title: Introduction to clover
text: Base-calling error rates reflect RNA modifications cause nanopore basecaller misidentify bases. Comparing error profiles conditions can reveal modification changes. Base-calling error profiles selected tRNAs.
code: # Load preprocessed bcerror data comparing wt vs TruB-del (tb) for 10 tRNAs bcerror_rds <- readRDS(clover_example("ecoli/bcerror_summary.rds")) bcerror_charged <- bcerror_rds$bcerror_charged bcerror_summary <- bcerror_rds$bcerror_summary # Plot error profiles for a few tRNAs plot_trnas <- c(   "host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Phe-GAA-1-1" )  plot_bcerror_profile(bcerror_summary, refs = plot_trnas)

title: Introduction to clover
text: Difference mean base-calling error (wt - TruB-del) across tRNAs positions.
code: # Compute delta (wt - tb); positive = higher error in wt (modification present) bcerror_delta <- compute_bcerror_delta(bcerror_summary, delta = wt - tb)  # Add Sprinzl coordinates and MODOMICS modification annotations sprinzl <- read_sprinzl_coords(   clover_example("sprinzl/ecoliK12_global_coords.tsv.gz") ) trna_fasta <- clover_example("ecoli/trna_only.fa.gz") mods <- modomics_mods(trna_fasta, organism = "Escherichia coli")  heatmap_data <- prep_mod_heatmap(   bcerror_delta,   sprinzl_coords = sprinzl,   mods = mods )  plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   cluster = FALSE,   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   highlight_col = "has_mod" )

title: Introduction to clover
text: MODOMICS database catalogs known RNA modifications. already used modomics_mods() annotate heatmap known modification positions. function maps MODOMICS entries onto reference sequences using pairwise alignment. Data common organisms bundled package (see modomics_organisms()), internet connection needed. can overlay known modifications onto base-calling error profiles. Positions known modifications often correspond elevated error rates, since basecaller misidentifies modified nucleotides. Base-calling error profiles known modification positions marked.
code: mods #> # A tibble: 698 × 4 #>    ref                     pos mod_full                 mod1  #>    <chr>                 <int> <chr>                    <chr> #>  1 host-tRNA-Ala-TGC-1-1    17 dihydrouridine           D     #>  2 host-tRNA-Ala-TGC-1-1    34 uridine 5-oxyacetic acid cmo5U #>  3 host-tRNA-Ala-TGC-1-1    46 7-methylguanosine        m7G   #>  4 host-tRNA-Ala-TGC-1-1    54 5-methyluridine          m5U   #>  5 host-tRNA-Ala-TGC-1-1    55 pseudouridine            Y     #>  6 host-tRNA-Ala-GGC-1-1    17 dihydrouridine           D     #>  7 host-tRNA-Ala-GGC-1-1    46 7-methylguanosine        m7G   #>  8 host-tRNA-Ala-GGC-1-1    54 5-methyluridine          m5U   #>  9 host-tRNA-Ala-GGC-1-1    55 pseudouridine            Y     #> 10 host-tRNA-Arg-ACG-1-1     8 4-thiouridine            s4U   #> # ℹ 688 more rows plot_bcerror_profile(bcerror_summary, refs = plot_trnas, mods = mods)

title: Introduction to clover
text: can highlight anticodon filled circles, mark discriminator base outline, change text color specific positions.
code: # Known modifications for this tRNA mods_glu_struct <- mods |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1")  # Look up sequence positions for Sprinzl anticodon (34-36) and # discriminator base (73) glu_coords <- sprinzl |>   filter(trna_id == "tRNA-Glu-UUC-1-1")  ac_pos <- glu_coords |>   filter(sprinzl_label %in% c("34", "35", "36")) |>   pull(pos)  disc_pos <- glu_coords |>   filter(sprinzl_label == "73") |>   pull(pos)  # Anticodon positions as filled circles anticodon <- tibble::tibble(   pos = ac_pos,   mod1 = rep("anticodon", 3) )  # Combine MODOMICS mods with anticodon highlight all_mods <- bind_rows(mods_glu_struct, anticodon)  # Discriminator base as an outline disc_outline <- tibble::tibble(pos = disc_pos, group = "discriminator")  # Change discriminator text to red disc_text <- tibble::tibble(pos = disc_pos, color = "#E41A1C")  svg_path <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = all_mods,   mod_palette = c(default_mod_palette(), anticodon = "#4DAF4A"),   outlines = disc_outline,   outline_palette = c(discriminator = "#E41A1C"),   text_colors = disc_text )

title: Introduction to clover
text: can visualize pairwise modification co-occurrence directly tRNA cloverleaf. Arcs connect position pairs significant odds ratios: blue arcs indicate mutual exclusivity (negative log ) vermillion arcs indicate co-occurrence (positive log ). Stroke width encodes magnitude.
code: or_data <- metadata(se)$odds_ratios  # Filter OR data for one tRNA and one sample, clean, and filter for # significance. filter_linkages() returns a tibble ready for plotting. linkages_glu <- or_data |>   filter(     ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1",     sample_id == "wt-15-ctl-01"   ) |>   clean_odds_ratios() |>   filter_linkages()  svg_path <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = mods_glu_struct,   linkages = linkages_glu )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: article visual gallery clover’s modification heatmap functions. covers every parameter plot_mod_heatmap() prep_mod_heatmap(), plus related plot_bcerror_profile() plot_mod_landscape() functions. examples use bundled E. coli base-calling error data shipped package.

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: bundled RDS contains pre-summarized bcerror data comparing wild-type (wt) TruB-deletion (tb) E. coli across 10 tRNAs. Compute per-position delta (wt minus TruB-del). Positive values mean higher error wild-type, indicating modification lost mutant.
code: bcerror_rds <- readRDS(clover_example("ecoli/bcerror_summary.rds")) bcerror_summary <- bcerror_rds$bcerror_summary bcerror_charged <- bcerror_rds$bcerror_charged bcerror_delta <- compute_bcerror_delta(bcerror_summary, delta = wt - tb) bcerror_delta #> # A tibble: 796 × 5 #>    ref                     pos     tb     wt     delta #>    <chr>                 <int>  <dbl>  <dbl>     <dbl> #>  1 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     1 0.0334 0.0405  0.00711  #>  2 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     2 0.0660 0.0896  0.0236   #>  3 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     3 0.0587 0.0809  0.0221   #>  4 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     4 0.195  0.201   0.00584  #>  5 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     5 0.258  0.288   0.0292   #>  6 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     6 0.117  0.134   0.0170   #>  7 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     7 0.125  0.133   0.00720  #>  8 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     8 0.0644 0.0706  0.00617  #>  9 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1     9 0.0623 0.0619 -0.000387 #> 10 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1    10 0.0295 0.0266 -0.00295  #> # ℹ 786 more rows

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Control diverging color scale color_limits, color_low, color_high, na_value. Custom color scale tighter limits purple-green palette. default palette uses colorblind-friendly blue (#0072B2) vermillion (#D55E00). Values outside color_limits squished extremes.
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   color_low = "#7B3294",   color_high = "#008837",   na_value = "gray95" )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: default, rows clustered using Ward’s D2 hierarchical clustering Sprinzl-position value matrix. Set cluster = FALSE keep alphabetical order. Clustered rows (default). Alphabetical row order (cluster = FALSE).
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1) ) plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   cluster = FALSE,   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1) )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: clustering, low-level noise can dominate distance matrix. Setting cluster_threshold restricts clustering positions least one tRNA exceeds threshold absolute value. Clustering uses positions |delta| > 0.05.
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   cluster_threshold = 0.05 )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: tRNAs belong natural groups (e.g., amino acid families), use group_col cluster within group draw horizontal dividers . First, add amino acid column data. Clustering within amino acid groups, separated dividers. Control divider line thickness divider_linewidth. Thicker dividers groups.
code: heatmap_grouped <- heatmap_data |>   mutate(amino_acid = sub("-.*", "", trna_label)) plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_grouped,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   group_col = "amino_acid" ) plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_grouped,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   group_col = "amino_acid",   divider_linewidth = 2 )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: prep_mod_heatmap() called mods, logical has_mod column marks known modification sites. Use highlight_col overlay dots cells. MODOMICS modification sites marked dots. Adjust dot appearance highlight_size highlight_offset (x/y displacement tile center). Larger highlight dots custom offset.
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   highlight_col = "has_mod" ) plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   highlight_col = "has_mod",   highlight_size = 1.2,   highlight_offset = c(-0.3, 0.3) )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Overlay text tiles label_col. Labels shown abs(value) >= label_min, text color automatically switches black white contrast. Reference bases overlaid tiles |delta| >= 0.03.
code: # Add the reference base at each position for labeling ref_seqs <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(trna_fasta) ref_bases <- tibble::tibble(   ref = sub("^host-", "", rep(names(ref_seqs), Biostrings::width(ref_seqs))),   pos = unlist(lapply(Biostrings::width(ref_seqs), seq_len)),   ref_base = strsplit(as.character(unlist(ref_seqs)), "") |> unlist() )  heatmap_labeled <- heatmap_data |>   left_join(ref_bases, by = c("ref", "pos")) plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_labeled,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   label_col = "ref_base",   label_min = 0.03,   label_size = 2 )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Customize fill legend fill_name fill_breaks, add explanatory text caption. Custom legend title, breaks, caption.
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   fill_name = "\u0394 error rate",   fill_breaks = c(-0.1, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.1),   caption = "Positive values = higher error in wt (modification present in wt, lost in TruB-del)." )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: default, square = TRUE uses coord_fixed(ratio = 1) square tiles. Set square = FALSE let ggplot2 fill available space, useful wide heatmaps many positions. Free aspect ratio stretches tiles fill plot area.
code: plot_mod_heatmap(   heatmap_data,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "trna_label",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1),   square = FALSE )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: plot_bcerror_profile() creates line plots per-position error rates, faceted tRNA colored condition. Error profiles three tRNAs.
code: plot_trnas <- c(   "host-tRNA-Asn-GTT-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Phe-GAA-1-1" )  plot_bcerror_profile(bcerror_summary, refs = plot_trnas)

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Pass mods tibble overlay vertical dashed lines known modification positions. Error profiles MODOMICS modification positions marked.
code: plot_bcerror_profile(bcerror_summary, refs = plot_trnas, mods = mods)

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Override condition colors named vector, change facet layout ncol. Custom colors two-column layout.
code: plot_bcerror_profile(   bcerror_summary,   refs = plot_trnas,   mods = mods,   colors = c(wt = "#E69F00", tb = "#56B4E9"),   ncol = 2 )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: plot_mod_landscape() creates stacked panel plot showing multiple metrics along tRNA sequence. metric gets panel sharing common x-axis. useful comparing error rates, mismatch types, per-position statistics side side. First, prepare single-tRNA data Sprinzl coordinates region annotations. Stacked landscape error rate mismatch frequency.
code: # Pick one tRNA and reshape for landscape plotting landscape_data <- bcerror_summary |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1", condition == "wt")  # Add Sprinzl coordinates and region info sprinzl_glu <- sprinzl |>   filter(trna_id == "tRNA-Glu-UUC-1-1") |>   select(pos, sprinzl_label, region)  landscape_data <- landscape_data |>   left_join(sprinzl_glu, by = "pos") |>   filter(!is.na(sprinzl_label))  # Add a logical column for known modification positions mod_positions <- mods |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1") |>   distinct(pos) |>   mutate(has_mod = TRUE)  landscape_data <- landscape_data |>   left_join(mod_positions, by = "pos") |>   mutate(has_mod = tidyr::replace_na(has_mod, FALSE)) plot_mod_landscape(   landscape_data,   metrics = c("mean_error", "mean_mis") )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Pass region_col add background shading structural regions (acceptor-stem, D-loop, anticodon-stem, etc.). Landscape structural region shading.
code: plot_mod_landscape(   landscape_data,   metrics = c("mean_error", "mean_mis"),   region_col = "region" )

title: Plotting modification heatmaps
text: Add secondary x-axis Sprinzl position labels using sprinzl_col. Use mod_col highlight known modification positions axis (shown bold orange ggtext installed). Full landscape regions, Sprinzl axis, modification highlights.
code: plot_mod_landscape(   landscape_data,   metrics = c("mean_error", "mean_mis"),   region_col = "region",   sprinzl_col = "sprinzl_label",   mod_col = "has_mod",   title = "tRNA-Glu-UUC-1-1 modification landscape",   heights = c(2, 1) )

title: Modification rewiring analysis
text: article demonstrates clover’s modification rewiring analysis workflow. “Rewiring” refers changes modification co-occurrence patterns conditions — position pairs may gain lose coordinated modification. workflow operates isodecoder level, collapsing gene copies increase statistical power. uses E. coli T4 phage infection dataset main vignette.

title: Modification rewiring analysis
code: config_path <- clover_example("ecoli/config.yaml")  sample_info <- data.frame(   sample_id = c(     "wt-15-ctl-01",     "wt-15-ctl-02",     "wt-15-ctl-03",     "wt-15-inf-01",     "wt-15-inf-02",     "wt-15-inf-03"   ),   condition = rep(c("ctl", "inf"), each = 3) )  se <- create_clover(   config_path,   types = c("charging", "odds_ratios"),   sample_info = sample_info )  or_data <- metadata(se)$odds_ratios or_data$condition <- ifelse(grepl("ctl", or_data$sample_id), "ctl", "inf")

title: Modification rewiring analysis
text: raw odds ratios may contain infinite values zero-cell contingency tables. clean_odds_ratios() caps reasonable threshold. Next, collapse per-gene odds ratios isodecoder level. averages across gene copies (e.g., tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1 tRNA-Glu-TTC-2-1 become tRNA-Glu-TTC).

what: Compare conditions with relative odds ratios
title: Modification rewiring analysis
text: compute_ror_isodecoder() computes relative odds ratio (ROR) two conditions z-score significance testing.

title: Modification rewiring analysis
text: Build matrix ROR values (isodecoders × position pairs) compute per-isodecoder rewiring scores. Run PCoA dimensionality reduction visualize result. PCoA tRNA modification rewiring control infected conditions.
code: mat <- prepare_rewiring_matrix(ror) scores <- calculate_rewiring_scores(mat) scores |> arrange(desc(euclidean_magnitude)) #> # A tibble: 4 × 5 #>   isodecoder        euclidean_magnitude mean_abs_change max_abs_change n_nonzero #>   <chr>                           <dbl>           <dbl>          <dbl>     <dbl> #> 1 host-tRNA-Gly-GCC               1.80           0.368           1.27          5 #> 2 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC               0.701          0.0987          0.543         2 #> 3 host-tRNA-Arg-ACG               0.611          0.0611          0.611         1 #> 4 host-tRNA-Asn-GTT               0.196          0.0264          0.174         2 pcoa <- perform_pcoa(mat) plot_pcoa_rewiring(pcoa, scores)

title: Modification rewiring analysis
text: Build chord diagram ROR data visualize modification rewiring positions. Chord diagram modification rewiring control infected conditions.
code: ror_agg <- ror |>   dplyr::group_by(pos1, pos2) |>   dplyr::summarise(log_ror = mean(ror), .groups = "drop")  plot_chord_ror(ror_agg, title = "Modification rewiring: inf vs ctl")

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: clover includes pre-computed tRNA cloverleaf SVGs can annotated modification highlights, outline circles, text color changes, linkage arcs. vignette walks every customization option plot_tRNA_structure() related functions.

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Bundled SVGs organized organism. Use structure_organisms() list available organisms structure_trnas() list tRNAs within organism.
code: structure_organisms() #> [1] "Escherichia coli"         "Homo sapiens"             #> [3] "Saccharomyces cerevisiae" "T4 phage" head(structure_trnas("Escherichia coli")) #> [1] "tRNA-Ala-GGC" "tRNA-Ala-TGC" "tRNA-Arg-ACG" "tRNA-Arg-CCG" "tRNA-Arg-CCT" #> [6] "tRNA-Arg-TCT"

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: simplest call renders bare cloverleaf base-pair lines, nucleotide letters, position markers every 10 nucleotides.
code: svg <- plot_tRNA_structure("tRNA-Glu-TTC", "Escherichia coli")

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: default, grey position numbers drawn every 10 nucleotides. Set position_markers = FALSE hide .
code: svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   position_markers = FALSE )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Modifications shown colored filled circles behind nucleotide letters. modifications argument takes tibble pos mod1 columns. Output modomics_mods() works directly filtering tRNA interest. Since plot_tRNA_structure() uses 1-based sequence positions, load Sprinzl coordinates convert named positions (like anticodon Sprinzl 34-36) actual sequence indices.
code: fasta_path <- clover_example("ecoli/trna_only.fa.gz") mods <- modomics_mods(fasta_path, "Escherichia coli") #> Processing 182 MODOMICS sequences. #> Matching MODOMICS sequences to reference FASTA. #> Found 698 modification annotations.  mods_glu <- mods |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1") mods_glu #> # A tibble: 11 × 4 #>    ref                     pos mod_full                          mod1    #>    <chr>                 <int> <chr>                             <chr>   #>  1 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    13 pseudouridine                     Y       #>  2 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    35 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine mnm5s2U #>  3 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    38 2-methyladenosine                 m2A     #>  4 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    54 5-methyluridine                   m5U     #>  5 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    55 pseudouridine                     Y       #>  6 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1     8 4-thiouridine                     s4U     #>  7 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    13 pseudouridine                     Y       #>  8 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    35 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine mnm5s2U #>  9 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    38 2-methyladenosine                 m2A     #> 10 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    54 5-methyluridine                   m5U     #> 11 host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1    55 pseudouridine                     Y sprinzl <- read_sprinzl_coords(   clover_example("sprinzl/ecoliK12_global_coords.tsv.gz") ) glu_coords <- sprinzl |>   filter(trna_id == "tRNA-Glu-UUC-1-1") svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = mods_glu )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: default_mod_palette() returns named character vector mapping modification short names colors. can extend override . add custom category (e.g., highlighting anticodon positions), combine MODOMICS modifications entries extend palette.
code: head(default_mod_palette(), 10) #>       m1A       m1G       m2A       m2G     m2,2G       m3C       m5C       m5U  #> "#E41A1C" "#984EA3" "#E68A00" "#66C2A5" "#8DA0CB" "#B3DE69" "#377EB8" "#FF7F00"  #>       m6A     m6t6A  #> "#FB9A99" "#D95F02" # Add anticodon positions (Sprinzl 34-36) as a custom category ac_pos <- glu_coords |>   filter(sprinzl_label %in% c("34", "35", "36")) |>   pull(pos)  anticodon <- tibble::tibble(   pos = ac_pos,   mod1 = rep("anticodon", 3) )  all_mods <- bind_rows(mods_glu, anticodon)  # Extend the palette with a color for the new category custom_palette <- c(default_mod_palette(), anticodon = "#4DAF4A")  svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = all_mods,   mod_palette = custom_palette )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Outlines draw stroke-circles around nucleotides, useful highlighting positions without covering base letter. outlines argument takes tibble pos group columns; outline_palette maps group names colors.
code: # Highlight the discriminator base (Sprinzl position 73) disc_pos <- glu_coords |>   filter(sprinzl_label == "73") |>   pull(pos)  disc_outline <- tibble::tibble(pos = disc_pos, group = "discriminator")  svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   outlines = disc_outline,   outline_palette = c(discriminator = "#E41A1C") )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Use text_colors change color nucleotide letters specific positions. takes tibble pos color columns.
code: # Color the anticodon triplet (Sprinzl 34-36) green ac_text <- tibble::tibble(   pos = ac_pos,   color = rep("#4DAF4A", 3) )  svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   text_colors = ac_text )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Modifications, outlines, text colors can used together.
code: disc_outline <- tibble::tibble(pos = disc_pos, group = "discriminator") disc_text <- tibble::tibble(pos = disc_pos, color = "#E41A1C")  svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = all_mods,   mod_palette = custom_palette,   outlines = disc_outline,   outline_palette = c(discriminator = "#E41A1C"),   text_colors = disc_text )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Pairwise modification co-occurrence can visualized arcs cloverleaf. linkages argument takes tibble pos1, pos2, optionally value columns. log_odds_ratio column present (output clean_odds_ratios() / filter_linkages()), used automatically. Arc color encodes direction: blue mutual exclusivity (negative log ) vermillion co-occurrence (positive log ). Stroke width encodes magnitude.
code: or_path <- clover_example(   "ecoli/summary/tables/wt-15-ctl-01/wt-15-ctl-01.odds_ratios_filtered.tsv.gz" ) or_data <- read_odds_ratios(or_path)  linkages_glu <- or_data |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1") |>   clean_odds_ratios() |>   filter_linkages() svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   modifications = mods_glu,   linkages = linkages_glu )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: linkage_palette parameter character vector length 2: first color used negative values (exclusive), second positive values (co-occurring). default c("#0072B2", "#D55E00").
code: svg <- plot_tRNA_structure(   "tRNA-Glu-TTC",   "Escherichia coli",   linkages = linkages_glu,   linkage_palette = c("#7570B3", "#D95F02") )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: Leu Ser tRNAs long variable arm extra stem-loop. properly rendered tRNAscan-SE covariance model alignment.
code: svg <- plot_tRNA_structure("tRNA-Leu-CAA", "Escherichia coli") svg <- plot_tRNA_structure("tRNA-Ser-GGA", "Escherichia coli")

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: plot_identity_structure() overlays experimentally validated aminoacylation identity elements (Giege & Eriani, 2023) onto cloverleaf. Strong determinants outlined red, weak determinants blue. requires Sprinzl coordinates map element positions onto tRNA sequence. Bundled coordinate files available E. coli S. cerevisiae.
code: coords <- read_sprinzl_coords(   clover_example("sprinzl/sacCer_global_coords.tsv.gz") )  svg <- plot_identity_structure(   "tRNA-Ala-AGC",   "Saccharomyces cerevisiae",   coords )

title: Plotting tRNA structures
text: plot_identity_panel() arranges multiple tRNAs grid, annotated amino acid family’s identity elements. Use ncol control number columns.
code: svg <- plot_identity_panel(   c("tRNA-Ala-AGC", "tRNA-Asp-GTC", "tRNA-Phe-GAA", "tRNA-His-GTG"),   "Saccharomyces cerevisiae",   coords,   ncol = 2 )

title: Plotting tRNA structures

title: Plotting and analysis for nanopore tRNA sequencing data
text: clover provides complete toolkit nanopore tRNA-seq analysis: Differential tRNA abundance — Test expression changes conditions using DESeq2, volcano plots tabular summaries. Charging analysis — Measure aminoacylation levels per tRNA compare across conditions, including joint abundance-charging visualizations. Base-calling error profiles — Visualize per-position error rates reflect RNA modifications, annotation overlays MODOMICS. Modification heatmaps — Map error rate differences Sprinzl coordinates cross-tRNA comparison modification signatures. tRNA secondary structure — Render cloverleaf diagrams annotated modifications, co-occurrence linkages, custom highlights (shown ). Modification co-occurrence — Compute odds ratios pairwise modification co-occurrence visualize chord diagrams, arc plots, structure overlays. clover opinionated file inputs assumes data processed aa-tRNA-seq-pipeline.

what: Aggregate odds ratios to isodecoder level. — aggregate_or_isodecoder

title: Aggregate odds ratios to isodecoder level. — aggregate_or_isodecoder
text: data tibble columns ref, pos1, pos2, log_or_clean (clean_odds_ratios()), p_value, total_obs. pattern Regular expression used strip gene copy numbers ref. Default "-\\d+-\\d+$" matches trailing -<copy>-<gene> suffixes.

title: Aggregate odds ratios to isodecoder level. — aggregate_or_isodecoder
